args.command:
cat > embed.py << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

mol = Chem.MolFromMolFile("mol_0246.mol", removeHs=False)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
mol_noH = Chem.RemoveHs(mol)
smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mol_noH)
print("target SMILES:", smi)

params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
params.randomSeed = 42
params.useRandomCoords = False
mh = Chem.AddHs(mol_noH)
cid = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, params)
print("embed status:", cid)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=2000)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mh, cleanIt=True, force=True)
smi2 = Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(mh))
print("embedded SMILES:", smi2)
print("match:", smi == smi2)
Chem.MolToXYZFile(mh, "answer.xyz")
EOF

content: The XYZ-only render lacks bond perception. Let me render the 3D structure with connectivity restored (from the mol template + 3D coords) to properly verify:

args.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, Draw
from rdkit.Chem.Draw import rdMolDraw2D
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

tmpl = Chem.MolFromMolFile("mol_0246.mol", removeHs=False)  # bonds+stereo, 28 atoms (2 explicit H)
xyz = Chem.MolFromXYZFile("answer.xyz")  # 44 atoms with H
# map: tmpl atoms 0..25 heavy in same order? tmpl has 28 atoms: 26 heavy + 2 explicit H at idx 26,27
# xyz order = AddHs(RemoveHs(tmpl)) order: heavy 0..25 then Hs appended; explicit H of tmpl become implicit->? RemoveHs removed them, AddHs re-added at end.
conf = xyz.GetConformer()
m = Chem.Mol(tmpl)
m.RemoveAllConformers()
c = Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
# heavy coords
for i in range(26):
    p = conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
    c.SetAtomPosition(i, Point3D(p.x, p.y, p.z))
# explicit H in tmpl (26,27) -> find matching H in xyz by proximity to heavy atom
import numpy as np
heavy_xyz = np.array([[conf.GetAtomPosition(i).x, conf.GetAtomPosition(i).y, conf.GetAtomPosition(i).z] for i in range(26)])
h_xyz = [(j, np.array([conf.GetAtomPosition(j).x, conf.GetAtomPosition(j).y, conf.GetAtomPosition(j).z])) for j in range(26, 44)]
for ti in (26, 27):
    parent = tmpl.GetAtomWithIdx(ti).GetNeighbors()[0].GetIdx()
    pp = heavy_xyz[parent]
    best = min(h_xyz, key=lambda t: np.linalg.norm(t[1]-pp))
    p = conf.GetAtomPosition(best[0])
    c.SetAtomPosition(ti, Point3D(p.x, p.y, p.z))
m.AddConformer(c)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
from rdkit.Chem import rdCIPLabeler
rdCIPLabeler.AssignStereochemistry(m)
for at in m.GetAtoms():
    if at.HasProp('_CIPCode'):
        print('stereocenter', at.GetIdx(), at.GetPropsAsDict()['_CIPCode'])
d = rdMolDraw2D.MolDraw2DCairo(900, 700)
rdMolDraw2D.PrepareAndDrawMolecule(d, m)
d.FinishDrawing()
open('check3d_b.png', 'wb').write(d.GetDrawingText())
print('rendered')
EOF
